Which Pump Fits Your Needs? Momcozy M5 vs M9
Choose Your Perfect Momcozy Pump Today — M5 or M9?
The right breast pump can make all the difference for new moms, and when comparing the Momcozy M5 vs M9 , there are several key differences to consider. The M5 comes with a lightweight design that's easy to use right out of the box, which is perfect for first-time moms. The M9 has stronger suctions (up to -300mmHg) and higher adjustable levels (1-15 levels). These models differ not just in tech features but also in their design, suction power, and milk collection systems.
Best-seller M5 is now M5 Smart !
Connect to the Momcozy App to track volume and control sessions from your phone.
The M9 Mobile Flow™ Hands-Free Breast Pump connects to your phone, letting you adjust settings and track pumping sessions through an app. The M5 Wearable Breast Pump keeps things simple with buttons right on the pump that you press to change settings. This basic difference affects how you'll use each breast pump every day.
Momcozy Mobile Flow™ Hands-Free Breast Pump | M9
The Momcozy M5 also does things the simple way, with its manual-only model that most moms adore for how easy it is. All of it is in front of you on the device itself, with buttons you can physically press to control modes and suction strengths as you pump. Without app connectivity, the M5 won't track or retain your pumping data, but it also means not having to deal with device pairing or phone charging before pumping. The M5's direct control system is plug-and-play right out of the box, so it is an option that is convenient for moms who simply want a no-gadget pumping experience with no need for a learning curve.
The M9 breast pump provides you with options that are in tune with your style. You can simply use the buttons on the pump itself – a wonderful option if you prefer an uncomplicated method without extra technology. Many moms like this hassle-free option for quick and convenient pumping sessions. Or if you're the type who likes to monitor, sync with your phone via the Momcozy app. This enables you to make adjustments without having to lift the pump while in use, and monitors your pumping sessions over time. Technologically oriented mothers will enjoy innovative features like Milk Boost™ to increase output, Milk Relief™ if you feel self-conscious, and the customized MyFlow™ Mode through which you can create a pumping routine that feels perfect for you. Whether you like to keep it simple or enjoy having your pumping data at hand, the M9 accommodates you.
Both the M5 and M9 breast pumps look and feel different while in use. The M5 breast pump is curved and lighter, while the M9 breast pump has a flat bottom to allow it to stand up on its own. The M5's lighter, simpler design weighs less in the bra, but the design of the M9 allows it to be easily set down between uses and not leak milk. The M9 features independent milk collectors, so you don’t need to wash or pour out the milk immediately after pumping.
The Momcozy M5 and M9 breast pumps also differ significantly in design, which affects both aesthetics and function. The M5 features a traditional s

emi-circular design that comfortably curves against the breast, while the M9 comes in a modern tear-drop shape that has a flat base for it to rest on when not in use.

Both the M5 and M9 are designed with simplicity in mind, featuring just five main components that are easy to assemble and clean.
Both models include these 5 parts:
Milk collectors made from Tritan™
M5 Smart Breast Pump Replacement Parts
The flanges on both Momcozy models are engineered with mom's comfort as a priority. Both the M5 and M9 feature the same innovative 105° angle design that better mimics a baby's natural latch.
Combination of hard and soft silicone
Mimics natural curvature of baby's mouth
3 flange inserts (17mm/19mm/21mm)
The M9 has a special DoubleFit™ Flange that combines soft silicone and hard silicone. The part touching your breast is soft for comfort, while the part connecting to the milk bowl is firm to prevent leaks. Momcozy's tests show this design enhances pumping efficiency by 28.2%, and increase leak-proof performance by 10%. The M5, on the other hand, uses only soft silicone throughout its flange.
The M9 features milk collectors made from Tritan™—a BPA-free, medical-grade material known for its durability, safety, and resistance to odors and stains, making it ideal for repeated use in daily pumping routines.
Includes lid for temporary storage
Can stand upright on flat surface
The M9 includes four milk collection cups in total – two standard plus two extras. What's really convenient is that these cups have flat bottoms, so once you're done pumping, you can simply snap on the lid and pop them straight in the fridge. The M5's cups have rounded bottoms that won't stand up on their own, so you'll need to transfer your milk to storage containers right after pumping.
The control panels on each model reflect their different technological capabilities, with the M9 offering more advanced features.
Yes (start, pause, stop via app)
Yes (records pumping sessions)
Yes - has a left/right switch button to easily track which breast you're pumping
The M9's enhanced interface supports its smart capabilities, while the M5 offers a simpler, more straightforward user experience that many moms find intuitive and easy to use right from the start.
M9 Wearable Breast Pump Replacement Parts
The M9 breast pump contains a newer and more adjustable motor with more features to help you express milk more efficiently. It has 15 suction levels along with special modes for maximizing milk output, whereas the M5 breast pump gives only nine general levels with none of the other features. If you tend to pump lots or experience challenges with milk flow, these differences between breast pumps can matter.
The motor is the heart of any breast pump, and Momcozy has come a long way between these two products. M5 employs Momcozy's 1st generation motor, which provides reliable performance for day-to-day pumping needs. M9, however, is a significant upgrade with its 3rd generation motor technology, providing better power efficiency and quieter operation. This new motor enables the M9's enhanced functionality without sacrificing battery life compared to the M5 in spite of added features.
Both pumps offer versatile pumping options, though the M9 provides more specialized patterns for different needs.
✓ Milk Boost™ (enhances production)
✓ Milk Relief™ (reduces engorgement)
✓ MyFlow™ mode (create personalized pumping patterns)
The suction capabilities between these two models show notable differences in both range and precision control.
More noticeable jumps between levels
Smoother transitions between levels
Can only adjust both sides together
Can control left and right sides independently
The M9's expanded suction range and additional levels allow for more precise control, which can be especially beneficial for moms with sensitive tis

sue or those who need to experiment to find their ideal settings. The M5 still provides effective suction for most users but with fewer adjustment options.
Both breast pumps take approximately the same amount of time on a charge—2-2.5 hours or 4-5 pumping sessions. The M5 breast pump is charged faster (2 hours) than the M9 breast pump (3 hours), but either will get you through a whole day of pumping before needing to be plugged back in.
Both the M5 and M9 Momcozy breast pumps are equipped with impressive battery life to keep up with busy moms in their day. Both pumps are equipped with rechargeable lithium-ion batteries that are able to sustain a consistent stream of power during multiple pumping sessions. With their batteries fully charged, both products tend to be able to sustain sufficient power to support 4-5 full pumping sessions or around 2-2.5 hours of continuous use. This allows most mothers to get through an entire day of pumping before needing to recharge, so these pumps are feasible options for working mothers or those who tend to be mobile.
Momcozy M5 vs M9 Breast Pump Technical Comparison
Vacuum Range (Stimulation Mode)
Vacuum Range (Expression Mode)
Cycle Speed (Stimulation Mode)
The M9 introduces thoughtful enhancements to protect the pump's internal components. Most notably, it includes a built-in dust plug for the charging port, which helps prevent dust, lint, and moisture from entering the USB-C connection. This small but significant feature helps extend the life of the charging port and reduces the risk of charging issues over time. The M5 does not include this protective feature, leaving the charging port exposed when not in use.
Both models feature smart charging protection to prevent overcharging, with automatic shutoff once the battery reaches full capacity. They also include battery level indicators on their displays, allowing you to monitor remaining power at a glance and plan your charging schedule accordingly.
Both the M5 and M9 come with carrying cases, so you can take either pump wherever you need to go. If you're looking for something super light, go with the M5. It won't weigh you down as much during those longer pumping sessions.
The M9 is a bit heavier, but it makes up for it with a nicer case that has separate compartments to keep all your pumping stuff organized. Plus, it runs quieter, which is great if you need to pump around others or during meetings.
When choosing a wearable breast pump, portability becomes a crucial factor for moms who are frequently on the move. The Momcozy M5 and M9 were both designed with mobility in mind, though they differ in several key aspects that affect their day-to-day convenience. While both models offer the freedom of wireless pumping, their weight, noise levels, and carrying options create distinct user experiences that might influence your preference.
The Momcozy M5 breast pump weighs just 230g (8.1 oz), noticeably lighter than the M9 at 280g (9.9 oz). The M9's slightly higher weight comes from its stronger motor and extra features, which provide better performance during your typical 30-minute pumping sessions. While the M9 is heavier due to its stronger motor and extra features, it offers a teardrop shape that better matches the natural curve of the breast, making it more discreet and less visible under clothing.
Both pumps are quiet, but the M9 is even more so. The M5 is <=50dB (a gentle whisper), which is fine for office use or night pumping sessions without disturbing your baby. The M9's upgraded motor quiets it down to <=48dB, making it an ultra-quiet device that's hardly audible in typical environments. This makes the M9 perfect for mothers who pump in open areas or at work.
Carrying Options and Travel Features
Both the M5 and M9 come with dust covers that keep dirt off the flanges when you're not using them. They also include carrying bags to hold all your pump parts in one place. These make it simple to take your pump anywhere - to work, on trips, or

around your home. The dust covers help keep the parts that touch your skin clean between uses.
Each of the breast pumps comes apart in the same way for washing, four large pieces and a dust cover to clean with each use. M9 breast pumps also include milk collector caps. If you use the cap, remember to wash it as well. Rinse your parts with the breast pump straight away, wash them in soapy water, and let them air dry completely.
Both Momcozy M5 and M9 pumps focus a lot on hygiene and convenience, with both sharing almost the same breakdown of parts that require regular cleaning. The best thing is that with both pumps, the motor unit (the electronic component) never comes in contact with breast milk itself and therefore does not require cleaning—wipe it with a moist cloth as and when required.
Recommended Cleaning Procedures
Momcozy recommends the same thorough cleaning protocol for both the M5 and M9 pump parts that come into contact with breast milk:
Daily Cleaning (After Each Use):
Disassemble all milk-contact parts (flange, silicone diaphragm, valve, and milk collector)
Rinse immediately after use with cool water to remove milk residue
Wash thoroughly with warm, soapy water using a dedicated brush (sold separately or use a clean bottle brush )
Rinse completely with clean water until all soap residue is removed
Air dry on a clean paper towel or drying rack
Wipe the motor unit with a slightly damp cloth if necessary (never submerge)
For parts that touch milk (silicone parts, collection bottles):
1. Rinse under running water to remove milk residue
2. Wash in a dedicated baby basin with soap and warm water (40-60°C)
3. Scrub with a clean brush used only for baby items
4. Rinse thoroughly and air-dry on a clean towel
5. Disinfect daily after cleaning (avoid microwave or UV sterilizers)
Warning : Always clean manually. Don't use antibacterial or abrasive cleaning agents as they may damage the parts.
1. Wash hands with hand sanitizer before starting
2. Wipe the main unit and charging cable with a clean soft cloth
3. Use 70% isopropyl alcohol wipes until no visible dirt remains
4. Let dry at room temperature for 10 minutes
5. For disinfection, dampen a soft cloth with 70% isopropanol and wipe for 3 minutes
6. Let dry for another 10 minutes at room temperature
Important Note: For both models, always allow all parts to completely air dry before reassembly to prevent mold growth. Store dry parts in a clean, sealed container between uses.
Both the M5 and M9 feature a user-friendly design with minimal parts, making assembly quick and straightforward for busy parents.
Enhanced diagram in manual guide
Prepare : Wash your hands thoroughly with soap and water. Ensure all parts that contact milk or breasts have been cleaned and disinfected.
Inspect : Check all components for cracks, chips, tears, or discoloration before assembly. Do not use damaged parts.
Attach diaphragm : Connect the diaphragm to the milk collector, applying gentle pressure around the edges until properly sealed.
Insert valve : Push the valve carefully into the flange, making sure there are no gaps.
Connect flange : Align the flange with the milk collector so the patterns overlap. Press down firmly with your thumbs to secure it around the rim.
Final assembly : Connect the pump motor to the milk collector assembly.
Your M5 breast pump is now ready to use.
Assemble milk bowl : Rotate the milk bowl in the direction of the lock icon at the mouth of the bottle.
Attach flange : Fasten the flange to the mouth of the bottle and connect it with the milk collector.
Final assembly : Connect the main unit to the assembled flange.
Your M9 breast pump is now ready to use.
Important : For both models, allow disinfected parts to cool completely if you've used boiling water, and avoid touching the inside of any milk collection parts.
The M9 breast pump costs $70 more than the M5 ($269.99 vs $199.99 for double pumps). This extra money gets you app control, more pumping options, quieter opera

tion. Whether it's worth it depends on how often you use your breast pump and if you'll actually use these extra features.
The Momcozy M5 and M9 represent different price tiers within the wearable breast pump market, with a notable difference in their investment levels:
What Does the Price Difference Get You?
The $70 price difference between the models reflects several enhanced features in the M9:
Advanced 3rd generation motor (vs. 1st generation in the M5)
Additional pumping patterns including Milk Boost™, Milk Relief™, and customizable MyFlow™
The M9 delivers stronger suction at 300mmHg maximum, while the M5 reaches 290mmHg.
Greater suction control with 15 levels (vs. 9 levels in the M5)
Lower noise level at <=48dB (vs. <=50dB in the M5)
Premium carrying case with compartments (vs. basic drawstring bag)
USB-C port dust cover for improved longevity
Independent control of left and right pumps
Milk collector made from Tritan™ —a BPA-free, medical-grade material known for its durability, safety, and resistance to odors and stains, making it ideal for repeated use in daily pumping routines
Budget-conscious moms who need a reliable wearable pump without premium features
First-time pumpers who aren't sure how frequently they'll use a pump
Occasional pumpers who may not benefit from the advanced features
Moms who prioritize lightweight design over additional functionality
When the M9 Is Worth the Investment:
Exclusive pumpers who will benefit from the specialized modes and additional suction levels
Moms with variable milk supply who need the Milk Boost™ and customizable features
Working professionals who value the ultra-quiet operation and premium carrying case
Experienced pumpers upgrading from a previous model who know they want more control options
Long-Term Value Considerations
The M9's more heavy-duty motor technology and dust protection features can have the effect of a longer working lifespan, arguably being better value in the long run even at its higher initial cost. The same 12-month guarantee is offered with each machine, although the M9's component build quality suggests it will maintain optimum performance longer if well looked after.
Many mothers report that the more comfortable settings and new modes of the M9 lead to more efficient milk expression, which can lead to time savings and increased milk production —benefits that are difficult to quantify in absolute monetary terms but have a meaningful impact on overall value for heavy users.
From the start of the pumping journey to returning to work , the M9 supports moms every step of the way.
The M5 breast pump is perfect if you pump occasionally and want something simple that works well without costing too much. The M9 breast pump makes more sense if you pump several times daily, need help with milk production, or want the convenience of controlling everything from your phone.
You're looking for value and simplicity ($199.99)
You pump occasionally rather than exclusively
You're new to pumping and prefer straightforward operation
You have a consistent milk supply without major challenges
You're on a tighter budget but still want wearable convenience
You prefer a lighter weight design for comfort
The M5 offers everything you need if you're primarily nursing with some pumping sessions mixed in. Its 9 suction levels and standard features handle basic pumping needs effectively without overwhelming you with options.
You need advanced features and customization ($269.99)
You pump frequently or exclusively throughout your day
You experience challenges with milk expression or letdown
You pump in public spaces or at work where noise matters
You need to adjust settings differently for each breast
You value additional comfort and control options
The M9 provides extra support with its specialized Milk Boost™ mode, 15 suction levels, and ultra-quiet <=48dB operation. The premium carrying case and enhanced durability features make it ideal for daily, intensive use.
Both breast pumps

are good choices—the difference is in matching the features to your specific situation. Consider the frequency of pumping, the location of use, and whatever special challenge you face. The right pump is one that becomes seamlessly part of your breastfeeding routine and makes your life easier.
Picking between the Momcozy M5 and M9 doesn't have to be complicated. If you pump occasionally and want something budget-friendly, grab the M5. If you pump often or need more features like quieter operation and custom settings, go with the M9. Don't overcomplicate it! Just match the pump with your lifestyle. Frugal occasional pumper? M5. Regular pumper with more needs? M9. That simple!
